verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail publishes a $20 per-check fee and names Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase, and Wells Fargo as banks that get complimentary overnight shipping. It also states that the physical check is mailed directly to your bank of deposit. missing for 10: an explicit supported-bank list or policy for other banks, a stated end-to-end deposit turnaround time beyond the overnight-shipping implication, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
